items.title: EXPOSED: Meta's Story Kit Turns Your Child's Toy Into an AI Story
items.summary:
Meta is testing Story Kit, an AI app that creates personalised bedtime stories with characters, settings, life lessons and music. The limited rollout is already raising a bigger question about which parts of parenting people are willing to automate.

In this episode of Front Page, we break down how Meta Story Kit uses the Muse Spark model from Meta Superintelligence Labs, how parents can turn a toy or person into a story character, why the app is restricted to users aged 18 and over, the role of AI safety filters, and the debate over whether AI-generated stories support busy parents or replace a meaningful family ritual.

items.title: Stop LLM LOOPS From Burning Millions of Tokens - w/ PUMA?
items.summary:
When allowing LLMs to "think" longer via test-time scaling (Chain-of-Thought), models often enter "cognitive stagnation": endlessly generating repetitive or vacuous tokens without making progress. 

Existing efficiency filters fail: entropy-based methods are tricked by "confident hallucinations" (low entropy, high confidence, wrong answer), and latent-based methods are computationally prohibitive because they evaluate completed trajectories post-hoc.

The authors (see below) present a new solution. 
The End of AI Overthinking and burning millions of tokens in a low entropy loop for no real result?

Graph engineering is the latest term spreading through AI Twitter, but the useful idea is how we structure work once one agent loop is not enough. In this video, I unpack Peter Steinberger's viral post and Hamel Husain's X Article, explain how retry cycles fit inside general directed workflows, and show what multi-agent orchestration looks like with Claude Code and Codex. We also cover the failure mode most diagrams ignore: reviewers built from the same model and context can share correlated blind spots. The practical takeaway is how to design state, parallel branches, outside verification, vetoes, budgets, and hard stops without building a forty-agent token furnace.
